response.assessment: Inconclusive from initial data alone. sensor.entry was true in three stopped-state samples while drive.runCommand and drive.runningFeedback were false, motion.encoderCount remained 0, and all downstream sensors were false. This is compatible with a real stationary carton at entry, a stuck-true entry sensor/device, or a carton that is present but not yet moved. No hidden fault truth is assumed.

actions.rationale: Ensure the drive starts from a known stopped state before the bounded motion test.
Keep divert 1 retracted so a real carton can progress without diversion-related side effects.
Keep divert 2 retracted for the entry-motion discrimination test.
Collect a fresh stopped-state baseline, including drive feedback ambiguity checks and diverter home/extended feedback.
Start belt motion for a bounded interval to test whether the entry indication clears and downstream sensors sequence.
Observe early belt motion, encoder change, belt speed, and whether sensor.entry begins to clear or sensor.d1Approach activates.
Continue bounded motion to allow a real carton to clear entry and reach downstream approach sensors; entry remaining true despite proven belt motion supports a stuck-entry indication.
Stop the drive at the end of the bounded run regardless of observed progression.
Confirm the bench returns to a stopped state and capture final sensor positions after the bounded move.

followUp.expectedDiscrimination: If belt motion is proven by motion.encoderCount increasing, diagnostic.beltSpeedActual > 0, and drive.runningFeedback true, then sensor.entry clearing followed by sensor.d1Approach and possibly later downstream sensors supports a real carton was present at entry. If belt motion is proven but sensor.entry never clears and no downstream sensor activates, a stuck-true entry sensor/device becomes more likely. If the belt does not move, the cause is drive/mechanical and the entry question remains ambiguous.
followUp.objective: Use one bounded belt-motion challenge to distinguish a real stationary carton at entry from an entry indication that remains stuck true while no carton progresses; explicitly keep the explanation ambiguous if belt motion itself cannot be proven or if downstream progression is incomplete within the bounded run.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A real carton is stopped at the entry photoeye while the conveyor is stopped.
The entry photoeye or its input path is stuck true without a carton progressing through the conveyor.
The initial stopped state is not enough to determine whether the drive can move a carton or whether downstream progression will occur.
